UMC is the leader in comprehensive healthcare delivery in West Texas and Eastern New Mexico. We have over 4,600 team members who have made our organization: 

Top three for the 10th  time in 11 years: The Best Place to Work in Texas Award 

Achieve Patient Experience Award for 6 years (2012-2018) from Healthgrades and achieve the Outstanding Patient Experience Award (2017-2018)

Earn the Women’s Choice Award as 1 of 100 best nationally for patient experience
 
Become a Magnet designated hospital--the 42nd facility in Texas and the first in West Texas 

Honored as the Designated Trauma Facility of the Year (2018) by the Texas Dept of State Health Services 

Recognized for Excellence in Patient and Employee Satisfaction by Press Ganey  

And so much more.

Subscribe to learn about how UMC Health System supersedes any other “county hospital” and delivers the best in care!
